C5 loads all baseline files (1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05) and all 92 target days for the 60x60 region, computes per-cell hazen 90th-percentile thresholds from ±5-day pools, then smooths them with a wrapped 31-day mean. The target days (doy 153-244) use smoothed days 138-259, whose pools span 12 May to 20 Sep of each baseline year. Every target-day SST of every sea cell is compared against its threshold, and the result goes through run detection and gap joining into the saved mhw_mask.nc."}
